digest.component_or_area: LLM model class system and configuration layer
propositions: Rebar's per-pass model selection (Pass-1/Pass-2/Pass-4) is inferred from equality tests rather than explicit configuration, causing silent downgrade failures when non-default providers are used
A single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL knob cannot express per-tier model mappings; plan-review and code-review pass conflicting model IDs to Anthropic and Bedrock respectively
The model_ladder in plan-review.yaml uses bare provider-specific names that hard-code Anthropic as the provider, breaking portability across Bedrock and other backends
Configuration layering must use deep merge for model-class tables and wholesale replacement for fallback arrays to allow per-key overrides without forcing repetition of sibling keys

Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must resolve to actual model IDs at three independent call sites (config.resolve_model, batch_runner ladder expansion, and verifier path) without introducing module-level import cycles

A real multi-provider gate run must demonstrate that per-pass model IDs correctly resolve across Bedrock and Anthropic when configured via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE, including proper provider_provenance capture
